notes.title: First patch!
notes.notes:
Implemented:
FPS limit, separate from vertical synchronization.
FOV customization. 
Ability to disable crosshair.
Bloom customization.

notes.title: Release!
notes.notes:
The game is already available at 20% off!
It's been a long journey, but here we are.

We hope you enjoy the game!

notes.title: DEMO version release date.
notes.notes:
The DEMO version of the game is scheduled to be released on November 11th, at 12pm EST.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41721856/0a3c32b333ef36fe3cbb4a386820c0fff49a2c2c.png

You will travel to a long-forgotten research complex and face your nightmares, in the form of entities from other dimensions.

notes.title: Postponing the game's release and opening the beta testing enrollment.
notes.notes:
The game's release date is being pushed back to 2024.
There are several reasons for this, the main ones being:
-The increased demands on the quality of the game.
-Unforeseen circumstances that occurred this year.

However, even though the game is postponed to the year 24, a public demo will be available in Q4!
The demo is scheduled to be released by November 30th.
Also, we are now open for closed testing of the part of the game that will be in the demo: https://forms.gle/LkZLCaH13s1DuWGZ6
Closed testing of the demo will start on January 15.
